Data Analyst Intern (Summer 2027)

Job ID
2027-1234
Category
Data & Analytics
Location
Chicago, IL, United States

Overview

Example Corp is hiring a Data Analyst Intern for Summer 2027. You will build dashboards, write SQL against our warehouse, and partner with product teams to turn questions into decisions that ship.

The internship runs twelve weeks from early June to late August and is based in our Chicago office with a hybrid schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Model data in SQL and dbt, and document the tables you own.
  • Build and maintain dashboards for the product and finance teams.
  • Design and read out A/B tests with your mentor.
  • Present a capstone project to the analytics leadership team.

Qualifications

  • Pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree, graduating between December 2027 and June 2028.
  • Comfortable with SQL and one of Python or R.
  • Able to work in the United States for the duration of the internship.

Example Corp is an equal opportunity employer.
